# Experimentation Analyst

**Bogreol Online ApS** · Copenhagen (hybrid) · 1 position

Bogreol is an online bookshop with 900,000 customers in the Nordics. Every change to our
shop is tested first, and we are looking for an analyst to make our experiments better.

## What you will do

- Design and analyse A/B tests on the shop, prices and newsletters.
- Improve our experimentation guidelines and tools.
- Present results to product teams and management.

## What we are looking for

- At least 2 years of work with experiments or analytics.
- Strong A/B testing: design, power, analysis and pitfalls.
- Solid statistics.
- Good SQL.
- Python for analysis.
- You must be allowed to work in the EU.

## Nice to have

- Sequential testing or other ways to stop experiments early.
- E-commerce experience.
- You present results clearly to non-technical colleagues.

We offer a book allowance, flexible hours and a quiet office above our warehouse.
